description.value: Yummy Slice Pizza is a Canadian-owned pizza-by-the-slice chain with numerous locations across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley, offering pickup and delivery. The Victoria Drive location sits on a busy commercial corridor in East Vancouver. The menu spans classic and signature pies including several South Asian-influenced vegetarian options, making it a versatile quick-stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood.
